body:

[Taita] Check topcashback as I think they are offering higher rate for sports items on Amazon.
[WwDesi] Currently unavailable.
We don't know when or if this item will be back in stock.
[lilviss] Says unavailable for me
I wonder how much quicker this is than standard dumbbells since you're still unscrewing the end
[Taita] I got this delivered yesterday. Amazon still let's me add more to cart for Sydney.
It's very quick to change weights as you only have to losen the screw to slot more plates in( Without unscrewing the whole thing). Have a look at this video 3:57 onwards
https://youtu.be/Qv37Nts2g90?si=bcpfFCG2oVDHsEh5
[nov1911] its not too bad cause you only have to unscrew it a little bit
basically much slower than quick change style dumbbells but should last forever compared to the cheap ones which are very fragile
[Taita] Hmm, it let's me add to cart for Sydney delivery
[DiscountAcquired] I was initially wanting these, was not available a year back. Ended up with 16 inch Olympic dumbbell handles.
Happy i went this way, no separate plates in my home gym just Olympic plates, and being 16inch not overly large and still capable of holding 40kg with slim latch collars. These would be handy if you bought x4 of them, and having a pair for mainly for lighter work and dropsets, then again id rather not have plates of different types lying around.
[Taita] I don't have a barbell yet so plan to get one for these plates. We did get 4 of these dumbells so we have extra plates plus like you said to keep a low and high pair ready to go. (we have different users at home so it will be handy.
